description: Pairs no longer traded (Android NotTraded.kt / iOS NotTraded.swift): stored lastError -> isMarker and the 24 h change that is shown (null = dash). Only the exact marker text counts. askSingleWhenMissing: pair missing from a complete bulk list -> ask it once by single ticker (not again once marked). confirmedBySingle: single result -> mark not traded only on a clear statement about the pair: answer without a price (no data, no error text), an explicit unknown-instrument text (does not exist, unknown asset pair, invalid symbol ...), the own reader text for a valid answer without an entry for the pair (exactly 'No data', or starting with 'Unknown coin' from Hyperliquid; only reached after the pair was missing from a complete bulk list) or HTTP 400/404; any other error (unreadable answer, unknown exception, network, timeout, rate limit, other 4xx, 5xx, missing adapter) stays an ordinary error. confirmWithoutBulk: without a bulk query (too few pairs) a single result is judged like confirmedBySingle only if the single request itself reads the complete list (Market.singleTickerReadsFullList: Lighter, Hyperliquid).
